repos_data.description: Go implementation of different backoff strategies useful for retrying operations and heartbeating.

70 independent Go packages for backend services: retry and exponential backoff, HTTP client and server, OpenTelemetry and Prometheus metrics, Argon2id password hashing, JWT, Redis and Valkey, Kafka, AWS S3 and SQS, SQL helpers, caching, and log redaction.
Lightweight Go SDK for Yandex Messenger Bot API — type-safe client with retry, rate-limit handling, and service-oriented architecture
